James Kettle DEF CON 34 / PortSwigger Research LangGraph 12-Agent Swarm

RFC Hunt Swarm & Protocol Ruler

Inspired by James Kettle: An autonomous, 12-agent research swarm orchestrated via LangGraph that extracts normative grammar rules and micro-inspiration from Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and IETF RFC specifications, synthesizes novel boundary and desynchronization probes via ModelFusion, executes stateful pipelined canary sequences against live HTTP/TLS endpoints, and delta-debugs reproducible anomalies.

LangGraph 12-Agent Autonomous Swarm Architecture

          

            Engineered to fulfill the requirements of James Kettle's research paper: de-anchored micro-inspiration, multi-model consensus, stateful TCP canaries, and autonomous discovery cascades.
          

        


        

          
          

            

              1
              
RFC Fetcher & Chunker

            

            

              Parses IETF RFCs (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, SMTP, PQC). Deconstructs texts into 1–3 sentence micro-inspiration fragments to prevent LLM context-contamination.
            

            
Modules: rfc_fetcher.py, rfc_chunker.py

          


          

            

              2
              
ABNF Grammar Compiler

            

            

              Extracts normative ABNF syntax trees (RFC 5234) and compiles grammar boundary constraints to discover syntax inversion vectors.
            

            
Module: abnf_engine.py

          


          

            

              3
              
ModelFusion Panel

            

            

              Zero-cost local Ollama consensus panel combining Gemma 2 (spec), Foundation-Sec (boundary exploitation), and DeepSeek R1 (reasoning arbiter).
            

            
Modules: fusion_engine.py, probe_generator.py

          


          

            

              4
              
Vector Permutator

            

            

              Permutes candidate probes across line-endings (\r\n, \n, \r), header folding, path null-bytes, and chunked transfer encodings.
            

            
Module: permutator.py

          


          

            

              5
              
Stateful Sequence Engine

            

            

              Executes the core 3-step canary sequence: Step 1 (Baseline GET) -> Step 2 (Candidate Probe) -> Step 3 (Canary Verification) on persistent TCP sockets.
            

            
Module: sequence_engine.py

          


          

            

              6
              
Differential Oracle

            

            

              Dispatches identical probes across multiple target web server engines and flags metamorphic status or latency divergences.
            

            
Module: differential_oracle.py

          


          

            

              7
              
Delta-Debugging Triage

            

            

              Recursively minimizes the triggering probe byte-by-byte to isolate the absolute minimum root-cause character sequence.
            

            
Module: delta_debugger.py

          


          

            

              8
              
Causal Anomaly Classifier

            

            

              Classifies discovered desynchronizations into discrete taxonomy: CL.0, TE.CL, Response Forking, Dangling-Byte Queue Poisoning, or Inline Leak.
            

            
Module: causal_classifier.py

          


          

            

              9
              
Autonomous Discovery Cascade

            

            

              Recursively feeds confirmed anomalies back into the generator as new inspiration seeds to explore adjacent vulnerability branches.
            

            
Module: cascade.py

          


          

            

              10
              
Protocol Ruler Engine

            

            

              Calibrates backend header limits down to the single byte and measures front-end byte transformation, Unicode expansion, and IP rewrite deltas.
            

            
Module: protocol_ruler.py

          


          

            

              11
              
Defensive Publisher

            

            

              Generates Snort/Suricata network signatures (Arm 106) and pytest regression suites (Arm 107) for reproducible patching.
            

            
Module: defensive_publisher.py

          


          

            

              12
              
Errata & Evolution Tracker

            

            

              Correlates discovered parser failures against official IETF technical errata and historical RFC supersession lifecycles.
            

            
Module: errata_tracker.py

          


        

      

    


    
    

      

        

          

            
Exhaustive CLI Flag & Parameter Reference

            

              Complete, verified documentation for all flags across the swarm CLI, modular toolkit, and standalone ruler.
            

          

          
        


        

          

            
              

                CLI Scope
                Flag / Option
                Type
                Default
                Purpose & Engineering Details
              

            
            
              
              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --mode
                choice
                single
                Selects scan operational mode: single (RFC by number), corpus (Kettle 138 specs), all (IETF registry), pqc (Post-Quantum & TLS 1.3), or ruler (Protocol Ruler).
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --rfc
                string
                9112
                Target RFC specification number when running in --mode single (e.g. 9112, 7230, 8446). The 'RFC' prefix is automatically sanitized.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --host
                string
                127.0.0.1
                Target IP address or domain. For remote domains, the engine dynamically normalizes raw Host: target.local probes to prevent routing drops.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --port
                integer
                5006
                Target network port. If set to 443, TLS is automatically enabled.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --tls
                flag
                False
                Wraps client TCP sockets in TLS context with hostname SNI and self-signed certificate tolerance.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --cycles
                integer
                3
                Maximum probe mutation and combinatorial exploration cycles to run for each scheduled RFC.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --timeout
                float
                900.0
                Process-scoped Ollama model inference timeout in seconds (900s = 15m). Set to 0 for unlimited timeout on massive resident models.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --sec-model
                string
                None
                Selects secondary security specialist model in ModelFusion (e.g. qwen2.5:7b, fenkohq/foundation-sec-8b:latest, deepseek-r1:1.5b).
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --debug
                flag
                False
                Enables James Kettle evaluation trace printing: socket connections, [REQ 1] baseline, [REQ 2] candidate probe, [REQ 3] canary check, and run-length compressed wire dumps.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                --show-response
                flag
                False
                Prints target host response status, latency, and essential protocol headers while stripping minified HTML/CSS/JS noise.
              

              

                rfc_hunt_swarm
                -v, --verbose
                flag
                False
                Enables complete payload tracing and displays full raw response bodies without summarization.
              


              
              

                protocol_ruler
                --max-size
                integer
                131072
                Upper boundary ceiling in bytes for coarse bracket search when calibrating backend header buffer limits (128 KB).
              

              

                protocol_ruler
                --sequence
                string
                None
                Custom byte sequence to test for front-end expansion/contraction (e.g. \xc0\x8a, hex string c08a, or literal characters).
              

              

                protocol_ruler
                --name
                string
                Custom Probe
                Human-readable label for custom probe sequences tested with --sequence.
              


              
              

                main.py
                --db
                string
                terminator.db
                SQLite database path for persisting fragments, generated probes, evaluation verdicts, and discovery cascade records.
              

              

                main.py
                --model
                string
                gemma2:2b
                Primary model used for zero-bias micro-inspiration hypothesis generation via Ollama or cloud fallback.
              

              

                main.py
                --no-fusion
                flag
                False
                Disables multi-model consensus panel arbitration, falling back to a single LLM generator agent.
